# RichMarkdownField Implementation Status

## Approach Taken

The implementation follows a **Glimmer/Ember-first** approach using ProseMirror as the core WYSIWYG engine, consistent with the TUI Editor Reverse Engineering Guide's recommendation to keep ProseMirror while replacing the UI layer with Glimmer components.

**Key architectural decisions:**
1. **ProseMirror via Ember Modifier** - Uses a `ProseMirrorModifier` class to mount/manage the editor, exactly as the guide recommends
2. **Custom Markdown Parser** - Instead of ToastMark, uses a simpler regex-based `parseFromMarkdown()` function
3. **Global State Storage** - Uses `Map<string, state>` for editor state instead of Ember services
4. **Boxel-Specific Extensions** - Adds card/field atom nodes and block cards for Boxel integration
5. **Single Mode** - WYSIWYG-only (no markdown editing mode)

---

## What's Already Done

### ✅ Phase 1: Foundation (Complete)
- [x] ProseMirror integration via Ember modifier
- [x] Comprehensive schema with 20+ node types:
  - Blocks: paragraph, heading (h1-h6), blockquote, code_block, bullet_list, ordered_list, list_item, table, table_row, table_cell, table_header, horizontal_rule
  - Inline: text, image, hard_break
  - Marks: strong, em, code, link
- [x] Boxel-specific nodes: `boxel_card_atom`, `boxel_field_atom`, `boxel_card_block`
- [x] Task lists with checkbox support

### ✅ Phase 2: Commands & Toolbar (Complete)
- [x] Full formatting toolbar with grouped buttons
- [x] Inline: bold (⌘B), italic (⌘I), code (⌘`), link (⌘K), image
- [x] Block: headings, paragraph, blockquote, code block, lists
- [x] Tables: insert 3x3 table
- [x] Task list toggle
- [x] Horizontal rule
- [x] Lift/outdent command
- [x] Undo/redo via history plugin
- [x] Keyboard shortcuts for all major commands

### ✅ Markdown Conversion (Complete)
- [x] `serializeToMarkdown()` - ProseMirror doc → markdown text
- [x] `parseFromMarkdown()` - markdown text → ProseMirror doc
- [x] `markdownToHtml()` - markdown → HTML for read-only display
- [x] Card/field directive syntax: `:card[Label]{id=...}`, `::card{id=... format=...}`

### ✅ Auto-Save & State (Complete)
- [x] Debounced auto-save (500ms)
- [x] Global editor state storage by ID
- [x] External content change detection
- [x] Save on blur
- [x] State persistence across re-renders

### ✅ Advanced Paste Handling (Complete)
- [x] Markdown detection and parsing on paste
- [x] Terminal copy cleanup (dedent, trailing space removal)

### ✅ Card Integration (Partial)
- [x] Card atom inline embedding with pill styling
- [x] Card atom hover popover (using Popover API)
- [x] Block card placeholders
- [x] Card reference extraction (`extractCardRefs`)
- [x] PrerenderedCardSearch integration in isolated view
- [ ] Actual card rendering inside markdown content

### ✅ Multiple View Templates
- [x] Edit: Full WYSIWYG editor with toolbar
- [x] Embedded: Styled HTML rendering
- [x] Atom: Plain text excerpt (50 chars)
- [x] Fitted: Truncated preview for grids
- [x] Isolated: Full reading layout with card search

---

## What's Left To Do

### Phase 3: Dual Mode & ToastMark (Not Started)

**Priority: Medium** - Only needed if you want markdown editing mode

- [ ] **Step 1**: Create ParserService wrapping ToastMark
  - Import `@toast-ui/toastmark` for incremental parsing
  - Expose `editMarkdown()`, `getRootNode()` APIs
  
- [ ] **Step 2**: Create ConvertorService
  - Port `toWwConvertors` (markdown AST → ProseMirror)
  - Port `toMdConvertors` (ProseMirror → markdown)
  - Handle cursor position mapping
  
- [ ] **Step 3**: Add mode switching UI
  - Mode toggle button (markdown ↔ WYSIWYG)
  - Convert document on mode change
  - Preserve cursor position
  
- [ ] **Step 4**: Markdown editor pane
  - Raw text editing with CodeMirror or ProseMirror plain schema
  - Live preview pane
  - Scroll synchronization

### Phase 4: Table Enhancements (Partial)

**Priority: High** - Tables are functional but basic

- [ ] **Step 1**: Table selection plugin
  - Port `tableSelection.ts` from TUI Editor
  - Multi-cell selection support
  
- [ ] **Step 2**: Table context menu
  - Right-click menu for table operations
  - Add/remove row/column
  - Merge/split cells
  
- [ ] **Step 3**: Table commands
  - `addRowAbove`, `addRowBelow`
  - `addColumnLeft`, `addColumnRight`
  - `deleteRow`, `deleteColumn`
  - `toggleHeaderRow`

### Phase 4: Custom NodeViews (Not Started)

**Priority: Medium** - Enhances editing experience

- [ ] **Step 1**: CodeBlockView
  - Language selector dropdown overlay
  - Syntax highlighting integration
  
- [ ] **Step 2**: ImageView
  - Click-to-select behavior
  - Resize handles
  - Alt text editing
  
- [ ] **Step 3**: CardBlockView
  - Render actual card component inside editor
  - Format selector (fitted/embedded)
  - Resize handles

### Phase 4: Toolbar State Plugin (Not Started)

**Priority: High** - Essential for good UX

- [ ] **Step 1**: Port `toolbarStateHighlight` plugin
  - Track active marks at cursor (bold, italic, etc.)
  - Track active block type (heading level, list, etc.)
  
- [ ] **Step 2**: Connect to tracked state
  - Update `@tracked toolbarState` on selection change
  
- [ ] **Step 3**: Update toolbar buttons
  - Show active state (highlighted) for current formatting
  - Show disabled state for unavailable commands

### Phase 4: Image Upload (Not Started)

**Priority: Medium**

- [ ] **Step 1**: Image paste handling
  - Detect image-only paste
  - Convert blob to upload or base64
  
- [ ] **Step 2**: Image drop handling
  - Port `dropImage.ts` plugin
  - Drag-and-drop support
  
- [ ] **Step 3**: Image upload hook
  - `addImageBlobHook` event
  - Integration with Boxel file storage

### Phase 5: Polish (Not Started)

**Priority: Low** - Nice to have

- [ ] **Responsive toolbar**
  - Overflow detection with ResizeObserver
  - Dropdown for hidden items
  
- [ ] **Dark mode theming**
  - CSS custom properties
  - Theme toggle
  
- [ ] **Accessibility**
  - ARIA attributes on toolbar
  - Keyboard navigation
  - Screen reader support
  
- [ ] **i18n**
  - Internationalized toolbar labels
  - ember-intl integration

### Services Architecture (Recommended)

**Priority: Medium** - Better code organization

Refactor from global Maps to Ember services:

- [ ] `SchemaService` - Centralize schema definition
- [ ] `CommandService` - Route commands, exec interface
- [ ] `EditorStateService` - Tracked state, view references
- [ ] `PluginRegistryService` - Plugin registration API

---

## Quick Wins (Immediate Impact)

1. **Toolbar Active State** - Add `toolbarStateHighlight` plugin to show which formatting is active
2. **Table Commands** - Add row/column insert/delete (most requested feature)
3. **Code Block Language** - Add language selector for syntax highlighting
4. **Image Paste** - Auto-upload pasted images

---

## Implementation Order Recommendation

1. **Toolbar Active State** (improves edit UX significantly)
2. **Table Commands** (tables are already there, just need more control)
3. **Image Upload** (common workflow need)
4. **CodeBlockView** (syntax highlighting)
5. **CardBlockView** (render actual cards in content)
6. **Dual Mode** (only if markdown editing is needed)

---

## UI/UX Improvements Needed for TUI Editor Parity

Based on the UI/UX Patterns guide, here are the detailed UX improvements needed:

### 1. Toolbar Visual States (Critical)

**Current:** Buttons have no visual feedback for active state
**Needed:** Four visual states per button:

| State | Current | Target |
|-------|---------|--------|
| Default | Plain button | Invisible border (same as bg color) |
| Hover | Basic hover | Border visible + white bg |
| Active | None | Highlighted icon + border |
| Disabled | None | 0.3 opacity |

**The Craft Secret:** Use invisible border (same color as background) in default state. On hover, change border color - no layout shift.

### 2. Toolbar State Binding (High Priority)

**Current:** Toolbar buttons don't reflect current formatting
**Needed:** Port `toolbarStateHighlight` plugin:

```
Cursor moves → Selection changes → Plugin fires
  → Inspect marks/nodes at selection
  → Emit state: { strong: {active: true}, heading: {level: 2}, ... }
  → Buttons update visual state
```

**Key Detail:** State is computed from *entire selection range*, not just cursor. Partially bold text shows bold as active.

### 3. Popup Patterns (Medium Priority)

**Current:** Using browser `prompt()` for links, images
**Needed:** Custom popup components:

- **Link popup**: URL input + link text input (400px)
- **Image popup**: Tabs (URL/File) + alt text
- **Heading popup**: H1-H6 list with actual font sizes as preview
- **Table popup**: Grid picker (20x20px cells)

**Positioning Algorithm:**
1. Position below button
2. Check overflow: clamp to toolbar bounds with 20px margin
3. Close on click outside, command exec, or mode switch

### 4. Tooltip System (Low Priority)

**Current:** Using browser `title` attribute
**Needed:** Custom tooltips:

- Immediate show on mouseenter (no delay)
- Position: 6px below button
- Style: Dark charcoal (#444), white text, 12px font
- Arrow pseudo-element

### 5. Table Interaction (High Priority)

**Current:** Basic table with no editing controls
**Needed:**

**Context Menu (right-click):**
```
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Add row above        │
│ Add row below        │
│ Remove row           │
├──────────────────────┤
│ Add column left      │
│ Add column right     │
│ Remove column        │
├──────────────────────┤
│ Align left/center/right │
├──────────────────────┤
│ Remove table         │
└──────────────────────┘
```

**Cell Selection:**
- Multi-cell selection with blue overlay
- Selection via ProseMirror Decorations
- Tab navigation: next cell → next row

### 6. Code Block Language Selector (Medium Priority)

**Current:** No language indication
**Needed:** CodeBlockView NodeView:

- Language label (top-right corner)
- Click to edit: transforms to input
- Syntax highlighting via Prism.js

### 7. List Behavior Refinements (Medium Priority)

**Current:** Basic list with Enter/Tab
**Needed:**

| Action | Current | Target |
|--------|---------|--------|
| Enter on empty item | Creates new item | Exits list, creates paragraph |
| Backspace on empty | Deletes | Merges with previous or lifts |
| Nested list outdent | Works | Lift to parent level |

**List Marker Styling:**
- Odd items: blue markers
- Even items: red markers
- Creates visual nesting distinction

### 8. Paste Intelligence (Partial - Extend)

**Current:** Markdown detection + terminal cleanup
**Needed:**

- **Office paste**: Detect RTF item, extract from Fragment markers
- **MSO list conversion**: Convert MsoListParagraph to proper lists
- **Table paste normalization**: Ensure consistent column counts
- **Image paste**: Detect blob, emit upload hook

### 9. Preview Highlighting (If Adding Dual Mode)

**Style:**
```css
.preview-highlight::after {
  background: rgba(255, 245, 131, 0.5);  /* Warm yellow */
  border-radius: 4px;
  position: absolute;
  inset: -4px;  /* 4px bleed */
  z-index: -1;
}
```

### 10. Typography System

**Current:** Basic heading sizes
**Needed:** Match TUI Editor scale:

| Level | Size | Special |
|-------|------|--------|
| H1 | 24px | 3px double border #999 |
| H2 | 22px | 1px solid border |
| H3 | 20px | No border |
| H4 | 18px | No border |
| H5 | 16px | Negative bottom margin |
| H6 | 14px | Negative bottom margin |

### 11. Selection & Focus (Low Priority)

**Needed:**
- Table cell selection: `background: #d8dfec`
- Selected table: `outline: 2px solid #00a9ff`
- Custom block selection: purple border
- Placeholder text via Decoration.widget

### 12. Responsive Toolbar (Low Priority)

**Algorithm:**
1. Calculate usable width
2. Accumulate item widths in loop
3. When overflow: move remaining to dropdown
4. Show "More" button (⋮)

### 13. Dark Mode (Low Priority)

**Key Overrides:**
| Token | Light | Dark |
|-------|-------|------|
| Primary | #00a9ff | #67ccff (cyan) |
| Background | #fff | #121212 |
| Code bg | #f9f2f4 | #35262a |
| Highlight | yellow 50% | yellow 25% |

### 14. Timing & Animation

**Current:** No animations
**Needed:** Minimal, focused animations:

| Element | Duration | Easing |
|---------|----------|--------|
| Toggle switch | 400ms | linear |
| Scroll sync | 100ms | ease-out |
| Everything else | instant | - |

**The Craft:** Almost no CSS animations. Responsiveness > flourish.

### 15. Accessibility (Low Priority)

**Needed:**
- `role="menu"` on context menu
- `role="menuitem"` on menu items
- `aria-disabled` on disabled items
- Focus returns to editor after popup close
- Semantic HTML output (h1-h6, strong, em, ul, ol, table, blockquote)

---

## UX Priority Matrix

| Feature | Impact | Effort | Priority |
|---------|--------|--------|----------|
| Toolbar active state | High | Medium | **1st** |
| Table context menu | High | Medium | **2nd** |
| Custom popups (link/image) | Medium | Medium | **3rd** |
| Code block language | Medium | Low | **4th** |
| Tooltips | Low | Low | 5th |
| List behavior polish | Medium | Low | 6th |
| Image paste/drop | Medium | Medium | 7th |
| Responsive toolbar | Low | Medium | 8th |
| Dark mode | Low | Medium | 9th |
| Accessibility | Medium | Low | 10th |

## Proposal: ToastMark Migration with Card Rendering Delegation

### Overview

Migrate from the current regex-based markdown parser to ToastMark for incremental parsing, using ToastMark's native `$$` custom block/inline syntax for Boxel card embedding. This enables proper AST representation while preserving full card format delegation.

### New Syntax Specification

#### Inline Card Reference (atom format)

```markdown
# Current syntax
:card[Jamie Chen]{id=./Person/jamie-chen}

# New ToastMark syntax
$$card Jamie Chen | ./Person/jamie-chen$$
```

**Structure:** `$$card LABEL | CARD_ID$$`

- `card` - directive name (parsed as `info` in AST)
- `LABEL` - display text for the pill
- `CARD_ID` - relative or absolute card URL

#### Inline Field Reference

```markdown
# Current syntax
:field[Due Date]{type=DateField data='2024-01-15'}

# New ToastMark syntax
$$field Due Date | DateField | 2024-01-15$$
```

**Structure:** `$$field LABEL | TYPE | VALUE$$`

For simple scalar values (strings, numbers, dates, booleans).

#### Block Card Embed (with format delegation)

```markdown
# Current syntax
::card{id=./Product/widget format=fitted width=320 height=200}

# New ToastMark syntax
$$card
id: ./Product/widget
format: fitted
width: 320
height: 200
$$
```

**Structure:** YAML-like attributes inside the block

#### Block Field Embed (with JSON data)

```markdown
# Simple field with scalar value
$$field
type: DateField
module: https://cardstack.com/base/date
label: Due Date
data: "2024-01-15"
$$

# Complex field with JSON object
$$field
type: AddressField
module: ./address
label: Shipping Address
data: {
  "street": "123 Main St",
  "city": "San Francisco",
  "state": "CA",
  "zip": "94102"
}
$$

# Compound field with nested structure
$$field
type: ContactInfoField
module: ./contact-info
format: embedded
data: {
  "name": "Jamie Chen",
  "email": "jamie@example.com",
  "phone": "+1-555-0123",
  "address": {
    "street": "456 Oak Ave",
    "city": "Portland",
    "state": "OR"
  }
}
$$
```

**Structure:**
- `type` - Field class name (e.g., DateField, AddressField)
- `module` - Module URL where field is defined (absolute or relative)
- `label` - Display label (optional)
- `format` - Render format: atom | embedded | edit (optional, default: embedded)
- `data` - JSON value (scalar, object, or array)

#### Field Data Formats

| Field Type | Data Format | Example |
|------------|-------------|--------|
| StringField | `"text"` | `"Hello world"` |
| NumberField | `123` or `123.45` | `42` |
| BooleanField | `true` or `false` | `true` |
| DateField | `"YYYY-MM-DD"` | `"2024-01-15"` |
| DateTimeField | `"ISO8601"` | `"2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"` |
| Contains (object) | `{ ... }` | `{ "name": "...", "value": ... }` |
| ContainsMany (array) | `[ ... ]` | `[{ "id": 1 }, { "id": 2 }]` |
| LinksTo | `"card-url"` | `"./Person/jamie"` |
| LinksToMany | `["url1", "url2"]` | `["./Tag/a", "./Tag/b"]` |

#### Relationship Field Examples

**Single Card Relationship (LinksTo):**

```markdown
# Author field linking to one Person card
$$field
type: LinksTo
module: https://cardstack.com/base/card-api
label: Author
computedType: ./person
data: "./Person/jamie-chen"
$$
```

**Multiple Card Relationships (LinksToMany):**

```markdown
# Tags field linking to multiple Tag cards
$$field
type: LinksToMany
module: https://cardstack.com/base/card-api
label: Tags
computedType: ./tag
data: [
  "./Tag/engineering",
  "./Tag/frontend",
  "./Tag/documentation"
]
$$

# Related Posts field linking to multiple BlogPost cards
$$field
type: LinksToMany
module: https://cardstack.com/base/card-api
label: Related Posts
computedType: ./blog-post
format: fitted
data: [
  "./BlogPost/intro-to-boxel",
  "./BlogPost/card-development-guide",
  "./BlogPost/prosemirror-tips"
]
$$
```

**Nested Relationships in Contains Field:**

```markdown
# A compound field with embedded card relationships
$$field
type: ProjectField
module: ./project
label: Current Project
format: embedded
data: {
  "name": "Website Redesign",
  "status": "in-progress",
  "lead": "./Person/sarah-miller",
  "team": [
    "./Person/jamie-chen",
    "./Person/alex-kim",
    "./Person/taylor-nguyen"
  ],
  "tags": [
    "./Tag/design",
    "./Tag/priority-high"
  ],
  "deadline": "2024-03-15"
}
$$
```

**Rendering Relationship Fields:**

When a field contains card relationships, the renderer should:

1. **Detect card URLs** in `data` values (strings starting with `./` or `https://`)
2. **Resolve the cards** via PrerenderedCardSearch
3. **Render in the specified format:**
   - `atom` → Show card pills inline
   - `fitted` → Show card grid/list with fixed dimensions
   - `embedded` → Show full card components in-flow

```typescript
function isCardUrl(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === 'string' &&
    (value.startsWith('./') || value.startsWith('https://'));
}

function extractCardRefs(data: unknown): string[] {
  const refs: string[] = [];

  function walk(val: unknown) {
    if (isCardUrl(val)) {
      refs.push(val);
    } else if (Array.isArray(val)) {
      val.forEach(walk);
    } else if (typeof val === 'object' && val !== null) {
      Object.values(val).forEach(walk);
    }
  }

  walk(data);
  return refs;
}
```

#### Supported Card Formats

| Format | Use Case | Dimensions | Rendering |
|--------|----------|------------|----------|
| `atom` | Inline pill | auto | Label + icon, hover preview |
| `fitted` | Grid cells | fixed w×h | Card's fitted template |
| `embedded` | In-flow block | 100% width | Card's embedded template |
| `isolated` | Full card | 100% width | Card's isolated template |
| `edit` | Editable | 100% width | Card's edit template |

### AST Representation

ToastMark will parse these into `customBlock` and `customInline` nodes:

```typescript
// Inline card: $$card Jamie Chen | ./Person/jamie-chen$$
{
  type: 'customInline',
  info: 'card',
  literal: 'Jamie Chen | ./Person/jamie-chen',
  // Parsed by our code into:
  // { label: 'Jamie Chen', cardId: './Person/jamie-chen', format: 'atom' }
}

// Inline field: $$field Due Date | DateField | 2024-01-15$$
{
  type: 'customInline',
  info: 'field',
  literal: 'Due Date | DateField | 2024-01-15',
  // Parsed by our code into:
  // { label: 'Due Date', fieldType: 'DateField', data: '2024-01-15' }
}

// Block card: $$card\nid: ./Product/widget\nformat: fitted\n$$
{
  type: 'customBlock',
  info: 'card',
  literal: 'id: ./Product/widget\nformat: fitted\nwidth: 320\nheight: 200',
  // Parsed by our code into:
  // { cardId: './Product/widget', format: 'fitted', width: 320, height: 200 }
}

// Block field with JSON: $$field\ntype: AddressField\ndata: {...}\n$$
{
  type: 'customBlock',
  info: 'field',
  literal: 'type: AddressField\nmodule: ./address\ndata: {\n  "street": "123 Main"\n}',
  // Parsed by our code into:
  // { 
  //   fieldType: 'AddressField', 
  //   module: './address',
  //   data: { street: '123 Main' }
  // }
}
```

### Implementation Plan

#### Phase 1: Bundle ToastMark (Week 1)

1. **Create ToastMark bundle**
   ```bash
   # Install dependencies
   npm install @toast-ui/toastmark entities mdurl
   
   # Bundle with esbuild
   esbuild node_modules/@toast-ui/toastmark/dist/esm/index.js \
     --bundle --format=esm --outfile=toastmark-bundle.js
   
   # Upload to Vercel blob storage
   ```

2. **Import in rich-markdown.gts**
   ```typescript
   import { ToastMark, Renderer } from 'https://your-blob.../toastmark-bundle.js';
   ```

3. **Create ToastMark wrapper service**
   ```typescript
   class MarkdownParser {
     private tm: ToastMark;
     
     constructor(content: string) {
       this.tm = new ToastMark(content);
     }
     
     edit(start: Pos, end: Pos, newText: string): EditResult {
       return this.tm.editMarkdown(start, end, newText);
     }
     
     getRoot(): Node {
       return this.tm.getRootNode();
     }
   }
   ```

#### Phase 2: Card & Field Directive Parsers (Week 1-2)

1. **Parse inline card syntax**
   ```typescript
   function parseCardInline(literal: string): CardAtomData {
     // "Jamie Chen | ./Person/jamie-chen"
     const [label, cardId] = literal.split('|').map(s => s.trim());
     return { label, cardId, format: 'atom' };
   }
   ```

2. **Parse inline field syntax**
   ```typescript
   function parseFieldInline(literal: string): FieldAtomData {
     // "Due Date | DateField | 2024-01-15"
     const parts = literal.split('|').map(s => s.trim());
     return {
       label: parts[0],
       fieldType: parts[1],
       data: parts[2],
       format: 'atom',
     };
   }
   ```

3. **Parse block card syntax**
   ```typescript
   function parseCardBlock(literal: string): CardBlockData {
     // "id: ./Product/widget\nformat: fitted\nwidth: 320"
     const attrs: Record<string, string> = {};
     for (const line of literal.split('\n')) {
       const [key, value] = line.split(':').map(s => s.trim());
       if (key && value) attrs[key] = value;
     }
     return {
       cardId: attrs.id || attrs.cardId,
       format: (attrs.format || 'embedded') as CardFormat,
       width: parseInt(attrs.width) || undefined,
       height: parseInt(attrs.height) || undefined,
     };
   }
   ```

4. **Parse block field syntax with JSON data**
   ```typescript
   function parseFieldBlock(literal: string): FieldBlockData {
     // Parse YAML-like header + JSON data block
     const lines = literal.split('\n');
     const attrs: Record<string, string> = {};
     let dataStart = -1;
     
     // Parse header lines until we hit 'data:'
     for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
       const line = lines[i];
       const colonIdx = line.indexOf(':');
       if (colonIdx === -1) continue;
       
       const key = line.slice(0, colonIdx).trim();
       const value = line.slice(colonIdx + 1).trim();
       
       if (key === 'data') {
         // Everything after 'data:' is JSON
         dataStart = i;
         // Check if JSON starts on same line
         if (value) {
           attrs.data = value + '\n' + lines.slice(i + 1).join('\n');
         } else {
           attrs.data = lines.slice(i + 1).join('\n');
         }
         break;
       }
       attrs[key] = value;
     }
     
     // Parse the JSON data
     let parsedData: any;
     try {
       parsedData = JSON.parse(attrs.data || '""');
     } catch (e) {
       // If not valid JSON, treat as string
       parsedData = attrs.data?.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
     }
     
     return {
       fieldType: attrs.type,
       module: attrs.module,
       label: attrs.label,
       format: (attrs.format || 'embedded') as FieldFormat,
       data: parsedData,
     };
   }
   ```

5. **Register custom HTML renderers**
   ```typescript
   const boxelRenderers = {
     customInline(node, context) {
       if (node.info === 'card') {
         const { label, cardId } = parseCardInline(node.literal);
         return {
           type: 'openTag',
           tagName: 'span',
           classNames: ['boxel-card-slot'],
           attributes: {
             'data-card-id': cardId,
             'data-format': 'atom',

           classNames: ['boxel-field-slot'],
           attributes: {
             'data-field-type': fieldType,
             'data-format': 'atom',

     customBlock(node, context) {
       if (node.info === 'card') {
         const { cardId, format, width, height } = parseCardBlock(node.literal);
         return {
           type: 'openTag',
           tagName: 'div',
           classNames: ['boxel-card-slot', `format-${format}`],
           attributes: {
             'data-card-id': cardId,
             'data-format': format,
             style: width ? `width:${width}px;height:${height}px` : '',

       }
       if (node.info === 'field') {

         return {
           type: 'openTag',
           tagName: 'div',
           classNames: ['boxel-field-slot', `format-${format}`],
   ```

#### Phase 6: Migration Script (Week 3)

1. **Convert existing content**
   ```typescript
   function migrateToToastMarkSyntax(markdown: string): string {
     // Inline: :card[Label]{id=...} → $$card Label | ...$$
     markdown = markdown.replace(
       /:card\[([^\]]*)\]\{id=([^}]+)\}/g,
       '$$card $1 | $2$$'
     );
     
     // Block: ::card{id=... format=... width=... height=...}
     markdown = markdown.replace(
       /::card\{([^}]+)\}/g,
       (_, attrs) => {
         const id = attrs.match(/id=([^\s}]+)/)?.[1];
         const format = attrs.match(/format=([^\s}]+)/)?.[1] || 'embedded';
         const width = attrs.match(/width=(\d+)/)?.[1];
         const height = attrs.match(/height=(\d+)/)?.[1];
         let block = `$$card\nid: ${id}\nformat: ${format}\n`;
         if (width) block += `width: ${width}\n`;
         if (height) block += `height: ${height}\n`;
         return block + '$$';
       }
     );
     
     return markdown;
   }
   ```

### Benefits of This Approach

1. **Incremental Parsing** - Only re-parse changed regions, not entire document
2. **Proper AST** - Cards are first-class AST nodes, not regex-matched text
3. **Format Delegation** - Full support for atom/fitted/embedded/isolated/edit
4. **Cursor Mapping** - Preserve cursor position across mode switches
5. **Extensible** - Easy to add new directive types (field atoms, etc.)
6. **Standard Syntax** - `$$` is ToastMark's official extension point

## Feature 7: Redline Track Changes

### Overview

Add CriticMarkup-compatible change tracking for collaborative editing, with accept/reject workflow and visual change indicators.

### CriticMarkup Syntax Specification

| Syntax | Purpose | Visual Rendering |
|--------|---------|------------------|
| `{++inserted text++}` | Addition | Green underline |
| `{--deleted text--}` | Deletion | Red strikethrough |
| `{~~old~>new~~}` | Substitution | Deletion + insertion |
| `{==highlighted text==}` | Highlight | Yellow background |
| `{>>reviewer comment<<}` | Comment | Dotted underline + popover |

```markdown
content: This text was removed
```

### Accept/Reject Workflow

| Action | Mark Type | Result |
|--------|-----------|--------|
| Accept insertion | `track_insertion` | Remove mark, keep text |
| Reject insertion | `track_insertion` | Remove mark and text |
| Accept deletion | `track_deletion` | Remove mark and text |
| Reject deletion | `track_deletion` | Remove mark, keep text |
| Accept all | All changes | Apply all accepts |
| Reject all | All changes | Apply all rejects |

### Commands Implementation

```typescript
const trackChangesCommands = {
  toggleTrackChanges: (state, dispatch) => {
    // Toggle tracking mode on/off
    const { trackingEnabled } = state;
    if (dispatch) {
      dispatch(state.tr.setMeta('trackChanges', !trackingEnabled));
    }
    return true;
  },
  
  acceptChange: (state, dispatch) => {
    const { $from } = state.selection;
    const marks = $from.marks();
    const changeMark = marks.find(
      m => m.type.name === 'track_insertion' || m.type.name === 'track_deletion'
    );
    
    if (!changeMark) return false;
    
    if (dispatch) {
      if (changeMark.type.name === 'track_insertion') {
        // Accept insertion: remove mark, keep text
        const tr = state.tr.removeMark(
          $from.start(),
          $from.end(),
          changeMark.type
        );
        dispatch(tr);
      } else {
        // Accept deletion: remove mark and text
        const tr = state.tr.delete($from.start(), $from.end());
        dispatch(tr);
      }
    }
    return true;
  },
  
  rejectChange: (state, dispatch) => {
    const { $from } = state.selection;
    const marks = $from.marks();
    const changeMark = marks.find(
      m => m.type.name === 'track_insertion' || m.type.name === 'track_deletion'
    );
    
    if (!changeMark) return false;
    
    if (dispatch) {
      if (changeMark.type.name === 'track_insertion') {
        // Reject insertion: remove mark and text
        const tr = state.tr.delete($from.start(), $from.end());
        dispatch(tr);
      } else {
        // Reject deletion: remove mark, keep text
        const tr = state.tr.removeMark(
          $from.start(),
          $from.end(),
          changeMark.type
        );
        dispatch(tr);
      }
    }
    return true;
  },
  
  addComment: (state, dispatch) => {
    const { from, to } = state.selection;
    if (from === to) return false;
    
    if (dispatch) {
      const commentId = crypto.randomUUID();
      const mark = state.schema.marks.comment_anchor.create({ commentId });
      dispatch(state.tr.addMark(from, to, mark));
    }
    return true;
  },
};
```

### Change Navigation Plugin

```typescript
const changeNavigationPlugin = new Plugin({
  key: new PluginKey('changeNavigation'),
  
  props: {
    handleKeyDown(view, event) {
      if (event.metaKey && event.shiftKey) {
        if (event.key === 'n') {
          // Navigate to next change
          navigateToChange(view, 'next');
          return true;
        }
        if (event.key === 'p') {
          // Navigate to previous change
          navigateToChange(view, 'prev');
          return true;
        }
      }
      return false;
    },
  },
});

function navigateToChange(view, direction) {
  const { doc, selection } = view.state;
  const pos = selection.from;
  
  const changes = [];
  doc.descendants((node, nodePos) => {
    node.marks.forEach(mark => {
      if (mark.type.name.startsWith('track_')) {
        changes.push({ pos: nodePos, mark });
      }
    });
  });
  
  if (changes.length === 0) return;
  
  let targetChange;
  if (direction === 'next') {
    targetChange = changes.find(c => c.pos > pos) || changes[0];
  } else {
    targetChange = [...changes].reverse().find(c => c.pos < pos) || changes[changes.length - 1];
  }
  
  if (targetChange) {
    view.dispatch(
      view.state.tr.setSelection(
        TextSelection.create(view.state.doc, targetChange.pos)
      ).scrollIntoView()
    );
  }
}
```

```handlebars
                  value={{this.width}}
                  min="100"
                  max="800"
                  step="10"
                  {{on "input" this.handleWidthChange}}
                />
                <span>px</span>
              </label>
              
              <label class="option-group">
                <span>Height:</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={{this.height}}
                  min="100"
                  max="600"
                  step="10"
                  {{on "input" this.handleHeightChange}}
                />
                <span>px</span>
              </label>
            {{/if}}
          </div>
        {{/if}}
        
        <footer class="chooser-footer">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="cancel-button"
            {{on "click" @onClose}}
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            class="insert-button"
            disabled={{not this.selectedCard}}
            {{on "click" this.confirmSelection}}
          >
            {{if (eq @mode "atom") "Insert Reference" "Embed Card"}}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  {{/if}}
</template>
```

### Component Logic

```typescript
import Component from '@glimmer/component';
import { tracked } from '@glimmer/tracking';
import { action } from '@ember/object';
import { restartableTask, timeout } from 'ember-concurrency';

interface CardChooserSignature {
  Args: {
    isOpen: boolean;
    mode: 'atom' | 'block';
    onSelect: (selection: CardSelection) => void;
    onClose: () => void;
    realmUrl: string;
    context: CardContext;
  };
}

interface CardSelection {
  cardId: string;
  label: string;
  format: 'atom' | 'fitted' | 'embedded' | 'isolated';
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
}

export default class CardChooser extends Component<CardChooserSignature> {
  @tracked searchQuery = '';
  @tracked selectedType: string | null = null;
  @tracked selectedCard: PrerenderedCard | null = null;
  @tracked results: PrerenderedCard[] = [];
  @tracked format: 'fitted' | 'embedded' | 'isolated' = 'fitted';
  @tracked width = 320;
  @tracked height = 200;
  
  availableTypes = ['Person', 'Document', 'Task', 'Product', 'Event'];
  
  @action
  handleSearchInput(event: Event) {
    this.searchQuery = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value;
    this.searchTask.perform();
  }
  
  @action
  setTypeFilter(type: string | null) {
    this.selectedType = type;
    this.searchTask.perform();
  }
  
  @action
  selectCard(card: PrerenderedCard) {
    this.selectedCard = card;
  }
  
  @action
  confirmSelection(card?: PrerenderedCard) {
    const selected = card || this.selectedCard;
    if (!selected) return;
    
    const selection: CardSelection = {
      cardId: selected.url,
      label: selected.title || selected.url.split('/').pop() || 'Card',
      format: this.args.mode === 'atom' ? 'atom' : this.format,
    };
    
    if (this.args.mode === 'block' && this.format === 'fitted') {
      selection.width = this.width;
      selection.height = this.height;
    }
    
    this.args.onSelect(selection);
  }
  
  searchTask = restartableTask(async () => {
    await timeout(300); // Debounce
    
    const query = this.buildQuery();
    const results = await this.args.context.search(query);
    this.results = results;
  });
  
  buildQuery() {
    const filter: any = {
      type: this.selectedType
        ? { module: `${this.args.realmUrl}${this.selectedType.toLowerCase()}`, name: this.selectedType }
        : undefined,
    };
    
    if (this.searchQuery.trim()) {
      filter.every = [{
        any: [
          { contains: { title: this.searchQuery } },
          { contains: { description: this.searchQuery } },
        ],
      }];
    }
    
    return { filter };
  }
  
  @action
  handleFormatChange(event: Event) {
    this.format = (event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as any;
  }
  
  @action
  handleWidthChange(event: Event) {
    this.width = parseInt((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || 320;
  }
  
  @action
  handleHeightChange(event: Event) {
    this.height = parseInt((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || 200;
  }
  
  @action
  stopPropagation(event: Event) {
    event.stopPropagation();
  }
}
```

### Integration with Rich Markdown Editor

```typescript
// In rich-markdown.gts

@tracked cardChooserOpen = false;
@tracked cardChooserMode: 'atom' | 'block' = 'atom';

@action
openCardChooser(mode: 'atom' | 'block') {
  this.cardChooserMode = mode;
  this.cardChooserOpen = true;
}

@action
closeCardChooser() {
  this.cardChooserOpen = false;
}

@action
handleCardSelected(selection: CardSelection) {
  const view = this.editorView;
  if (!view) return;
  
  const { state } = view;
  const { tr } = state;
  
  if (selection.format === 'atom') {
    // Insert inline card atom
    const node = state.schema.nodes.card_atom.create({
      cardId: selection.cardId,
      label: selection.label,
    });
    tr.replaceSelectionWith(node);
  } else {
    // Insert block card
    const node = state.schema.nodes.card_block.create({
      cardId: selection.cardId,
      format: selection.format,
      width: selection.width,
      height: selection.height,
    });
    tr.replaceSelectionWith(node);
  }
  
  view.dispatch(tr);
  view.focus();
  
  this.closeCardChooser();
}
```

### UI Flow

1. **User clicks "@" toolbar button** (or types "@" trigger)
2. **Modal opens** with search field auto-focused
3. **User types to search** → debounced query runs, results update
4. **User clicks type filter** → results filter to that card type
5. **User clicks a card** → card becomes selected (highlighted border)
6. **For block mode:** User selects format and optionally sets dimensions
7. **User clicks "Insert"** (or double-clicks card) → card inserted at cursor
8. **Modal closes**, focus returns to editor

### Keyboard Navigation

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `↑` `↓` `←` `→` | Navigate card grid |
| `Enter` | Select highlighted card |
| `Escape` | Close modal |
| `Tab` | Move between controls |
| `1-9` | Quick select card by position |

### Query Pattern

```typescript
// Search by title or description
const query = {
  filter: {
    type: selectedType ? {
      module: `${realmUrl}${selectedType.toLowerCase()}`,
      name: selectedType,
    } : undefined,
    every: searchQuery ? [{
      any: [
        { contains: { title: searchQuery } },
        { contains: { description: searchQuery } },
      ],
    }] : undefined,
  },
  sort: [{ by: 'lastModified', direction: 'desc' }],
  page: { size: 20 },
};
```

### Accessibility

- Modal traps focus when open
- `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`
- Close button has `aria-label`
- Grid items are buttons with card title as accessible name
- Selected state announced via `aria-selected`
- Escape key closes modal
- Focus returns to trigger button on close
